_about: 9-slice margins in source pixels of the @1x art (number = all sides, [h, v] or [left, top, right, bottom]); ArtSource/UI/NineSlice@2x.json has the @2x values. Generated by Tools/BlenderArt/ui_chrome/build.py (gongbi mounting style).
